newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up, consolidate recovery.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up, consolidate recovery.

text.p: Dhaka stocks consolidated their recovery on Tuesday from a deep correction, making heavy gains on both retail and institutional buying, brokers said.
The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) rose 90 points or 4.88 percent at 1,933.67 on a turnover of 47.3 million taka. Of 91 issues traded, 80 gained, nine lost and two unchanged.

Brokers said scrips faced correction in recent bearish spell were gaining back buyers. They also attributed the positive market sentiment to the easing of political tension following the opposition's return to the parliament on Wednesday. Square Pharma rose 122 taka to 1,343 and Apex Foods lost 1,176 to 10,588.
